# FG-SYS-0002

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`config-invalid`](../../ops/runbooks/config-invalid.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `config_invalid_is_alerting_500` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: サーバーの設定に問題があります。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The server configuration is invalid. Contact the administrator.
- id: Konfigurasi server tidak valid. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

The configuration file or environment is missing a required value or contains an invalid one; detected at startup or on reload.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `config_key` and `reason`. `config_key` is a key such as `database.url` (its environment variable is derived: `FORGE_DATABASE_URL`), `config_file` (then see `path`), or an unknown `FORGE_*` variable (a typo). Layers, later wins: config file (`--config` / `FORGE_CONFIG`) → environment → command-line flags. `reason` is one of missing, invalid, empty, zero, above_max, unknown_key, unknown_env, renamed (see `renamed_to`), not_unicode, unreadable, parse (see `line` / `column`; the offending text is not logged), password_in_url (use `database.password_file`), query_in_url (the URL is only postgres://user@host[:port]/dbname — TLS, timeouts and options come from the configuration), libpq_env (a PG* variable such as PGPASSWORD or PGSSLROOTCERT is set; `config_key` names it — unset it), not_absolute, insecure_permissions (Unix: the password file must not be readable by group or others; see `mode`). Secret values are never logged.

## 対処 (fix)

Correct the value named by `config_key` in the configuration file or environment and restart. Never commit secrets to the config sample.
